AdminAnnouncement.title: AdminAnnouncement
AdminAnnouncement.description: Developer and owner announcement or banner managed exclusively by the authorized owner account (alnaziali0@gmail.com). Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt and updatedAt.

title.description: Headline of the announcement or banner (1..160 chars).

badgeLabel.description: Category badge label displayed on the glassmorphic banner (1..60 chars).

actionUrl.description: Optional external HTTPS link or action reference (0..500 chars).

isActive.description: Whether the announcement is currently visible.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the owner creator.

authorEmail.description: Verified Google account email of the authorized developer (alnaziali0@gmail.com).

updatedAt.description: Last update server timestamp (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/admin_announcements/{announcementId}.description: Owner-managed developer announcements restricted strictly to verified Google account alnaziali0@gmail.com.
